actor.agentId: general-purpose subagent of the claude-fable-5 coordinator session

summary: Read-only performance audit of the fair-D4 hot path (docs/exploratory/audit-06-engine-efficiency.md): census-based Amdahl bounds; a one-entry board memo in the leaf prototyped and measured bit-exact at 1.64x/1.87x per decision on synthetic roots (indicative); -march=native shown to change the leaf's bit pattern via FMA contraction with -ffp-contract=off restoring it; the learned-leaf build's unpinned -march=native verified to alter 17.0% of frozen-leaf values (0 of 13 probe columns); GPU batched-leaf, lockstep-game and NNUE-leaf verdicts with first experiments; memory and cheap-win analysis.
validationPerformed: All timings taken at load ~30 beside a 30-thread cohort and reported as back-to-back ratios only; synthetic states from the 0x5eed playground domain; no research seed opened; no repository file other than the report modified
limitations: Self-reported; the subagent runtime did not expose its model identifier, so it is recorded as unknown (the Agent tool inherits the parent session's model by default).
Memo ratios are indicative pending real lease roots, a printed hit rate and a 30-way parallel confirmation.
